## 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g., "I'm frustrated when I try to...").

## 🎯 Describe the Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include examples of the command syntax you would like to see (e.g., `./badge_gen.sh custom-cmd ...`).

## 🛠️ Implementation Strategy (Optional)
If you have ideas on how to achieve this without altering the core `badge_gen.py` architecture or lowering the **96% code coverage**, please outline them here.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or structural concepts about the feature request here.
